scripts.build:cli: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @dh-care-plan/cli run build
scripts.build:pwa: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @dh-care-plan/pwa run build
scripts.test: pnpm run build:core && pnpm -r --stream --workspace-concurrency=1 run test
scripts.dev: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @dh-care-plan/pwa run dev
scripts.serve: pnpm run build:core && pnpm --filter @dh-care-plan/pwa run serve
scripts.link:cli: pnpm run build:cli && pnpm --filter @dh-care-plan/cli exec pnpm link --global
scripts.deploy: pnpm run test && pnpm run build:pwa && pnpm --filter @dh-care-plan/pwa run deploy
scripts.deploy:shadow: pnpm run test && pnpm run build:pwa && pnpm --filter @dh-care-plan/pwa run deploy:shadow
